The casino you love to hate

MrQ is the casino you love to hate. Love us when you win, hate us when you lose. That's gambling, and we're not going to pretend otherwise.

No wagering. Keep what you win.

Most casinos hand you a bonus, then quietly expect you to stake it dozens of times before you can withdraw a penny. We think that’s daft. We have no wagering requirements on our promotions; other terms apply. Winnings from our promotions are paid in cash. Our minimum withdrawal is £10.

Our withdrawal guarantee

Under our withdrawal guarantee, we process eligible withdrawals within 60 seconds of your request. If we don’t, eligible players get a £10 cash credit within one business day, limited to one per player per calendar day. Exclusions apply, including withdrawals held for verification checks and payment issues outside our control, such as a problem with your bank or payment provider; the full terms are on the guarantee page.

How long a processed withdrawal takes to reach you depends on your bank or payment provider.

Pay your way

Fund your account the way you already pay for everything else. Deposit and withdraw straight from your bank with pay by bank, or top up in a tap with Apple Pay and Google Pay. Debit cards and PayPal too. No faff, no fees from us, and a £10 minimum across the board.

Fair, licensed and built for your phone

MrQ is operated by Tek Fox Ltd and licensed and regulated by the UK Gambling Commission under account 60629. That means fair games, protected funds, and rules we actually follow. And it all works the way it should on your phone, because that’s where most of you play.

We back more than the games

We don’t just run a casino, we back the stuff worth watching. You’ll find MrQ on fight night with Queensberry Promotions, across the action on DAZN, and behind football clubs with real support: AFC Bournemouth, Queens Park Rangers and Sheffield Wednesday. We’re at The O2 too, one of the biggest arenas in the country. We back the moments people actually care about, the same way we run the casino. No fuss, no fake fanfare, just the good stuff.
